Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2026-08-11

This privacy policy describes how Clover Time Wiki ("we", "us", or "our") handles information when you visit this website.

Information We Collect

Clover Time Wiki is a static website. We do not require you to create an account or submit personal information. We do not directly collect or store personal data.

Third-Party Services

When enabled, third-party services may collect information as described in their respective privacy policies:

Advertising partners (e.g. Google AdSense, Adsterra) — may use cookies to serve relevant ads. You can opt out of personalized advertising via your browser settings.
Analytics (e.g. Google Analytics, Cloudflare Web Analytics) — GA may collect anonymized usage data such as page views and approximate location (cookie-based, loaded only after you accept the consent banner); Cloudflare Web Analytics is cookieless and collects aggregate page-view data.
Cloudflare — when used as the hosting provider, it may process basic request data for security and performance (and serve Web Analytics when enabled, see above).
Comments (giscus, opt-in) — when the comment section is enabled, giscus.app loads an embedded GitHub view; viewing it exposes your IP address and browser info to that service, and signing in to comment is handled by GitHub under its own privacy policy.
Embedded videos (YouTube) — pages with videos load thumbnail images from i.ytimg.com and, after you press play, the YouTube player from youtube-nocookie.com. Until you interact, no YouTube cookies are set.
Cookies

Some third-party services set cookies. You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling cookies may affect ad personalization but will not prevent you from accessing site content.

Children's Privacy

Clover Time Wiki is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.

Use of Content

All guides, articles, and reference material on this site are provided for personal, non-commercial use. You may not copy, republish, or redistribute our content without attribution and a link back to the original page.

Accuracy

We strive for accuracy but make no warranties regarding the completeness or correctness of any content. Clover Time is frequently updated, and information may become outdated. Always verify critical information in-game.

Third-Party Links

This site links to external websites (official game channels, video tutorials, etc.) that we do not control. We are not responsible for the content or practices of third-party sites.

Trademarks

Clover Time and related trademarks, logos, and assets belong to their respective rights holders. Clover Time Wiki is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by AnimeCore Studio.

Limitation of Liability

Use of this site is at your own risk. We are not liable for any damages arising from your use of the site or reliance on its content.

Changes to These Terms
